bio.text: Robin Ficker is the Republican candidate for Maryland's 6th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election and a former member of the Maryland House of Delegates.
He was born in Takoma Park, Maryland, served in the U.S. Army from 1960 to 1966, and graduated from the U.S. Military Academy at West Point in 1965.
He also holds a graduate degree from American University and a law degree from the University of Baltimore School of Law, and has worked as a real estate broker and farmer.
